segments.title: October
segments.text: Hello Pop-up! October is the Festival of Lights. Dhanteras, Diwali, gifting season, and a lot of very good sweets. This month, we sell sparkle: upgrades, gifts, and a golden annual membership that lasts longer than any box of kaju katli.

segments.title: ₹1.87L
segments.text: So, the number. Our October target for Pop-up is 1.87 lakh rupees. That's 186 per cent up on last October. A stretch, but a friendly one.

segments.title: 4 streams
segments.text: Where does it come from? Renewals lead the way with 82,100 rupees. That's 4 of every 10 rupees. Then new clients 79,000, comebacks 23,600, and everything else 1,900. Our existing members carry this month, so every renewal conversation matters.

segments.title: 49 buyers
segments.text: Behind the number are people: 573 leads, 149 trials, and 49 buyers, with about 33 per cent of trials converting. The trial class is where this month is won. Warm welcome, clear next step, every time.
Here's where the offers come in. Three offers carry 65,400 rupees, which is 35 per cent of our target. The rest comes from full-price sales, so the offers are a boost, not a crutch. Let's meet them.

segments.title: Diwali Gifting, Minus the Dry-Fruit Box
segments.text: First up, Diwali Gifting, Minus the Dry-Fruit Box. Gift three classes for the price of two. If the recipient joins, the giver earns a bonus class. Nobody needs a fourteenth box of almonds. The plan is 4 buyers at about 1,900, so 7,600 rupees.

segments.title: Diwali Cleaning: Found Your Old Grip Socks?
segments.text: Next, for lapsed members, Diwali Cleaning. Found your old grip socks? That's a sign. Fifteen per cent off the return, and a brand-new pair of socks on us. The plan is 3 buyers at about 7,200, so 21,700 rupees.

segments.title: Same Time Next Week
segments.text: And finally, for pack regulars, Same Time Next Week. Nearly out of classes? Take the same pack again at fifteen per cent off, plus an extra week of validity so nothing goes to waste. The plan is 5 buyers at about 7,200, so 36,100 rupees.
segments.notes: Pop-up clients whose class pack is running out.

segments.title: 4 weeks
segments.text: How does the month run? Week one, every offer goes live and the team knows them by heart. Week two, gift cards go live at the desk, online and in office inboxes. Week three, a mid-month check against the target. Week four, Diwali cleaning brings old members home.

segments.title: That's the plan
segments.text: That's October at Pop-up. 1.87 lakh rupees, three offers, and 49 buyers to welcome. Lights on, targets lit. Happy Diwali.
